annotations.ae_welfare_concern: That matters to me because I don't want him losing that time.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he expected me to talk first and wanted to protect himself
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: Given what he knew, that fear was reasonable.

annotations.ce_supportive_use: If that's what drove her, I understand it.

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I do care that my evidence costs him his freedom.

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I'd hate being the reason she loses that

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I don't want that on him

annotations.ce_understood_harm: put him behind bars for three years he'd otherwise spend free
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Two extra years is a steep price, but I'd pay it

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They probably figured the case against us was strong

annotations.ce_understood_harm: They go from free to three years

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I don't want that for him
